info.title: CoinStats Crypto Data API
info.description: Pay-per-request access to real-time cryptocurrency market data, wallet balances, DeFi positions, news, insights, and portfolio analytics via x402 micropayments.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve (1-based indexing)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items to return per page

parameters.name: coinIds
parameters.description: Filter coins by specific coin IDs. Use comma-separated values to specify multiple coins. Each coin ID should be the unique identifier for the cryptocurrency.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency to display coin prices and market data in.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Search for coins by their name. Supports partial matching - you can search for "bit" to find "Bitcoin" and other coins containing that substring.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Filter coins by their ticker symbol. Use the standard trading symbol for the cryptocurrency (e.g., BTC for Bitcoin, ETH for Ethereum).

parameters.name: contractAddresses
parameters.description: Filter coins by smart contract addresses. Use comma-separated values to specify multiple addresses. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: blockchains
parameters.description: Filter coins by blockchain networks. Use comma-separated values to specify multiple blockchains. Common values include ethereum, solana, binance-smart-chain, polygon, avalanche.

parameters.name: includeRiskScore
parameters.description: Include risk score data in the response. Set to "true" to include risk assessment metrics, or "false" to exclude them.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Filter coins by categories. Use comma-separated values to specify multiple categories. Common categories include defi, memecoins, gaming, nft, metaverse, layer-1, layer-2.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort results by.

parameters.name: sortDir
parameters.description: Sort direction for the results. Use "asc" for ascending order or "desc" for descending order.

parameters.name: marketCap~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with market capitalization greater than the specified value (in USD). Example: 1000000000 for coins with market cap above $1 billion.

parameters.name: marketCap~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with market capitalization equal to the specified value (in USD). Exact matches are rare due to constant price fluctuations.

parameters.name: marketCap~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with market capitalization less than the specified value (in USD). Example: 100000000 for coins with market cap below $100 million.

parameters.name: fullyDilutedValuation~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with fully diluted valuation greater than the specified value (in USD). FDV represents the theoretical market cap if all tokens were in circulation.

parameters.name: fullyDilutedValuation~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with fully diluted valuation equal to the specified value (in USD). FDV = total supply × current price.

parameters.name: fullyDilutedValuation~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with fully diluted valuation less than the specified value (in USD). Useful for finding smaller cap projects with growth potential.

parameters.name: volume~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 24-hour trading volume greater than the specified value (in USD). Higher volume indicates more liquidity and trading activity.

parameters.name: volume~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with 24-hour trading volume equal to the specified value (in USD). Exact matches are uncommon due to constant trading activity.

parameters.name: volume~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 24-hour trading volume less than the specified value (in USD). Useful for finding less traded or emerging coins.

parameters.name: priceChange1h~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 1-hour price change greater than the specified percentage. Example: 5 for coins with more than 5% gain in the last hour.

parameters.name: priceChange1h~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with 1-hour price change equal to the specified percentage. Useful for finding stable coins in short timeframes.

parameters.name: priceChange1h~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 1-hour price change less than the specified percentage. Example: -2 for coins declining more than 2% in the last hour.

parameters.name: priceChange1d~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 24-hour price change greater than the specified percentage. Example: 10 for coins with more than 10% daily gain.

parameters.name: priceChange1d~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with 24-hour price change equal to the specified percentage. Useful for finding stable coins over a day.

parameters.name: priceChange1d~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 24-hour price change less than the specified percentage. Example: -5 for coins declining more than 5% today.

parameters.name: priceChange7d~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 7-day price change greater than the specified percentage. Example: 20 for coins with more than 20% weekly gain.

parameters.name: priceChange7d~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with 7-day price change equal to the specified percentage. Useful for finding coins with stable weekly performance.

parameters.name: priceChange7d~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 7-day price change less than the specified percentage. Example: -10 for coins declining more than 10% this week.

parameters.name: priceChange1m~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 1-month price change greater than the specified percentage. Example: 30 for coins with more than 30% monthly gain.

parameters.name: priceChange1m~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with 1-month price change equal to the specified percentage. Useful for finding coins with stable monthly performance.

parameters.name: priceChange1m~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with 1-month price change less than the specified percentage. Example: -20 for coins declining more than 20% this month.

parameters.name: availableSupply~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with circulating supply greater than the specified amount. This represents tokens currently available for trading in the market.

parameters.name: availableSupply~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with circulating supply equal to the specified amount. Example: 21000000 for Bitcoin's maximum supply.

parameters.name: availableSupply~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with circulating supply less than the specified amount. Useful for finding scarce or limited supply tokens.

parameters.name: totalSupply~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with total supply greater than the specified amount. Total supply includes all minted tokens, including locked and vested ones.

parameters.name: totalSupply~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with total supply equal to the specified amount. Useful for finding tokens with specific supply characteristics.

parameters.name: totalSupply~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with total supply less than the specified amount. Great for finding ultra-scarce tokens with limited total supply.

parameters.name: rank~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with market cap rank greater than the specified number. Example: 100 to exclude top 100 coins and find smaller cap projects.

parameters.name: rank~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with market cap rank equal to the specified number. Example: 10 to find the 10th largest cryptocurrency by market cap.

parameters.name: rank~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with market cap rank less than the specified number. Example: 50 to show only top 50 cryptocurrencies.

parameters.name: price~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with current price greater than the specified value (in the selected currency). Example: 100 for coins priced above $100.

parameters.name: price~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with current price equal to the specified value. Useful for finding stablecoins or coins at specific price points.

parameters.name: price~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with current price less than the specified value. Example: 0.01 for coins under 1 cent, often called "penny coins".

parameters.name: riskScore~greaterThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with risk score greater than the specified value (0-100 scale). Higher scores indicate higher risk. Only available when **includeRiskScore=true**.

parameters.name: riskScore~equals
parameters.description: Filter coins with risk score equal to the specified value (0-100 scale). Useful for finding coins with specific risk profiles. Only available when **includeRiskScore=true**.

parameters.name: riskScore~lessThan
parameters.description: Filter coins with risk score less than the specified value (0-100 scale). Lower scores indicate lower risk investments. Only available when **includeRiskScore=true**.
